scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: npx concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
